EXAM: CT CHEST WITHOUT CONTRAST

CLINICAL HISTORY:
Pulmonary nodule follow-up.

COMPARISON:
None available.

FINDINGS:

LUNGS AND AIRWAYS:
There is a 6 mm solid pulmonary nodule in the anterior right upper lobe. A 5 mm perifissural nodule is present in the left lower lobe. No focal airspace opacity.

MEDIASTINUM AND HILA:
Subcarinal lymph node measures 9 mm in short axis.

UPPER ABDOMEN:
No acute abnormality in the visualized upper abdomen.

OTHER:
Left thyroid lobe nodule measures 1.2 cm.

IMPRESSION:

1. 6 mm right upper lobe pulmonary nodule and 5 mm left lower lobe perifissural nodule.
2. Mildly prominent 9 mm subcarinal lymph node.
3. 1.2 cm left thyroid nodule.

EXAM: CT CHEST WITHOUT CONTRAST

CLINICAL HISTORY:
Follow-up pulmonary nodules.

COMPARISON:
CT chest 01/09/2024.

FINDINGS:

LUNGS AND AIRWAYS:
Apical right upper lobe solid nodule measures 6 mm and is unchanged. New 10 mm ground-glass opacity in the anterior left upper lobe, favored infectious or inflammatory. No other new suspicious pulmonary nodule.

MEDIASTINUM AND HILA:
No mediastinal or hilar lymphadenopathy.

OTHER:
Left thyroid lobe nodule is unchanged.

IMPRESSION:

1. Stable 6 mm right upper lobe pulmonary nodule.
2. New 10 mm anterior left upper lobe ground-glass opacity. Short-interval follow-up is recommended to document resolution.
3. Stable left thyroid nodule.

EXAM: CT CHEST WITHOUT CONTRAST

CLINICAL HISTORY:
Pulmonary nodule surveillance.

COMPARISON:
CT chest 07/15/2024.

FINDINGS:

LUNGS AND AIRWAYS:
Right upper lobe solid nodule now measures 7 mm, previously 6 mm. The 5 mm left lower lobe perifissural nodule is unchanged. Previously seen anterior left upper lobe ground-glass opacity has resolved. No new suspicious pulmonary nodule.

MEDIASTINUM AND HILA:
Subcarinal lymph node measures 10 mm in short axis, previously 9 mm.

IMPRESSION:

1. Slight interval increase in size of the right upper lobe nodule, now 7 mm.
2. Stable 5 mm left lower lobe perifissural nodule.
3. Resolved left upper lobe ground-glass opacity.
4. Minimally increased 10 mm subcarinal lymph node.

EXAM: CT CHEST WITHOUT CONTRAST

CLINICAL HISTORY:
Continued pulmonary nodule surveillance.

COMPARISON:
CT chest 01/20/2025.

FINDINGS:

LUNGS AND AIRWAYS:
Anterior right upper lobe nodule measures 7 mm and is unchanged. No recurrent left upper lobe ground-glass opacity. No new suspicious pulmonary nodule.

MEDIASTINUM AND HILA:

OTHER:
1.2 cm left thyroid lobe nodule is unchanged.

IMPRESSION:

1. Stable 7 mm right upper lobe pulmonary nodule.
2. No recurrence of the previously resolved left upper lobe ground-glass opacity.
3. Stable 10 mm subcarinal lymph node and stable left thyroid nodule.
